title: Twists to the Spin Structure of the Ln9 Diabolo Motif Exemplified in Two {Zn2Ln2}[Ln9]{Zn2} Coordination Clusters

synthesis.procedure: Shared aerobic preparation of 1 and 2: o-vanillin (0.2 mmol) and (1S,2S)-trans-2-aminocyclohexanol hydrochloride (0.2 mmol) were stirred in MeOH (20 mL) for 2 h to give a clear pale yellow solution. LnCl3·5H2O (0.1 mmol; Ln = Gd for 1) and Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 56 mg) were added with Et3N (0.45 mmol, 61 μL). After a further 1 h stirring the colorless solution was filtered and the filtrate left to evaporate slowly in air. Colorless needle crystals of 1 were collected after 13 days (15% based on LnIII).

synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution, filtration, slow evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left for slow evaporation in air; colorless needles collected after 13 days

properties.summary: dc susceptibility of fresh [Zn4Gd11]·19MeOH shows χMT = 78.2 cm3·K/mol at 300 K (1000 Oe), below the 86.7 cm3·K/mol spin-only value for 11 GdIII; a minimum of 75.8 cm3·K/mol at 14.0 K then a rise to 79.4 cm3·K/mol at 1.8 K indicates dominant ferromagnetic or competing antiferromagnetic (ferrimagnetic) coupling. Magnetization saturates at 67.6 μB (7.0 T, 2.0 K), below 77.0 μB expected for 11 uncoupled/ferromagnetically aligned GdIII, implying mixed spin orientations in the diabolo core. Reduced M vs H/T isotherms superpose, consistent with isotropic GdIII. No optical properties reported.

synthesis.procedure: Isostructural analogue of 1 using the same aerobic MeOH procedure with DyCl3·5H2O (0.1 mmol) in place of the Gd salt. Colorless needle crystals of 2 were collected after 27 days (21% based on LnIII).

properties.summary: χMT of [Zn4Dy11]·19MeOH is 143.6 cm3·K/mol at 300 K (1000 Oe), below 155.8 cm3·K/mol for 11 free DyIII; it falls to 115.9 cm3·K/mol at 12.5 K then rises to 157.2 cm3·K/mol at 1.8 K, consistent with intramolecular ferro- or competing antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization at 2–5 K does not saturate to 7 T and reduced M vs H/T curves do not superpose, indicating anisotropy/low-lying states. Frequency-dependent ac signals occur even at 0 dc field (1.8 K) but χ″ maxima lie outside the window; under 1000 Oe (1.8–4.0 K) an Arrhenius fit gives Ueff = 4.4 K and τ0 = 5.2×10−5 s, assigned to slow relaxation from interacting DyIII centers (SMM-like) rather than a single-ion process. Magellan electrostatic axes in the Dy4 squares are toroidal and ~37° from the Dy4 plane. No optical properties reported.
